name: Tick Buffer
description: Holds early clicks and releases back until the first tick where you survive, then lets them through.

max-delay-ticks.name: Max Delay (ticks)
max-delay-ticks.description: How long an input can be held back. 240 ticks = 1 second, so 4 ticks is about 1 frame at 60 FPS. 8 to 16 is the usual range.

horizon-ticks.name: Safety Lookahead (ticks)
horizon-ticks.description: How many ticks ahead each input is tested for survival. For very early clicks this must cover the whole jump, so raise it together with Max Delay. Higher costs more per test and can wrongly reject a click that needs a second click soon after.

buffer-releases.name: Buffer Releases
buffer-releases.description: Also hold back button releases. Needed for wave and other hold-based modes.

drop-on-timeout.name: Drop Input If Never Safe
drop-on-timeout.description: If no safe tick is found within the max delay, throw the input away instead of letting it through.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Write a line to the Geode log each time an input is released, with how many ticks it waited.
